result.instructions: Read fsm://docs/spec and fsm://executor for mode, handlers, arguments and outcome events. Workflow: executor_check (repair and recheck) → machine_create (dry_run first) → instance_create → instance_send. Consult enabled_events and deadlines_pending. Writer mode: run effects, effect_ack, send outcome events and deadline_poll when due. Executor progress: autonomous runs effects, deadlines and recovery with quiet clients (keep stdio stdin open; HTTP disconnects do not stop the host). Legacy client_requests needs requests to drive ticks. Subscribe to fsm://instance/{id} for updates; polling and subscriptions only observe autonomous progress. Decimal values are JSON strings. Retry the SAME request_id after timeout; corrected content needs a NEW id. simulate runs without effects or deadline polls.
